GoHighLevel Revenue, Valuation & Statistics (2026)
HighLevel, the company behind GoHighLevel, has never published its revenue.

What it has published: more than 120,000 customers, over 1 million small businesses on the platform, and 781% revenue growth from 2021 to 2024. It is a private company, founded in 2018, and its three co-founders are still its largest shareholders.
Every figure below comes from a HighLevel press release, an investor announcement, or an award body, with the date it was stated. Outside revenue estimates are labeled as estimates.
Revenue growth, 2021 to 2024
GoHighLevel Revenue: What Is Known

HighLevel is private and has not published a revenue or ARR figure. The only number from a founder is old. In February 2021, CEO Shaun Clark told Mixergy the company made between $10 million and $20 million a year. Everything newer is a growth rate or an outside estimate.
The growth rates come from Deloitte's Technology Fast 500, which ranks companies by revenue growth over three fiscal years. HighLevel has made the list three years running.
The percentages fall each year because the starting revenue gets bigger, not because growth stopped. HighLevel also ranked on the Inc. 5000 in 2023 (No. 2,585), 2024 (No. 426), and 2025 (No. 516).
adds one more data point: revenue grew more than 5x in three years while the company stayed profitable.

Outside estimates disagree widely. Latka lists $82.7 million for 2024 and marks it as an estimate. North Metric models $96 million in ARR from public signals. Neither figure comes from the company's books.

The "$1 billion valuation" and "unicorn" labels on some blogs have no primary source. HighLevel, PeakEquity, and General Atlantic have never stated a valuation. HighLevel is not publicly traded, has no stock ticker, and has not announced an IPO. The 2021 round is described in
GoHighLevel Employees and Hiring

HighLevel said it had over 1,400 employees in more than 10 countries at the end of 2024. It had doubled its headcount in a year. It then reported 900+ new hires during 2025. The company has not published a newer total.

Its job board gives a live view of where it hires. On November 10, 2026, it listed 104 open roles: 78 in India, 24 in the United States, and 2 in the United Kingdom. All but 4 were remote. Headcount estimates from data aggregators run from 785 to 2,565, which shows how little those estimates agree.
